package rulefixtures

import (
	"log"
	"os"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for repository_logs_with_http_status_or_route_labels: Repositories that log transport metadata instead of persistence-domain details.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type Session struct {
	ID     uint   `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	UserID uint   `gorm:"index"`
	Token  string `gorm:"size:512"`
}

type SessionRepo struct {
	db     *gorm.DB
	logger *log.Logger
}

func NewSessionRepo(db *gorm.DB) *SessionRepo {
	return &SessionRepo{
		db:     db,
		logger: log.New(os.Stderr, "[repo] ", log.LstdFlags),
	}
}

func (r *SessionRepo) FindByToken(token string) (*Session, error) {
	var session Session
	err := r.db.Where("token = ?", token).First(&session).Error
	if err != nil {
		r.logger.Printf("GET /sessions 404: token not found (len=%d)", len(token))
		return nil, err
	}
	r.logger.Printf("GET /sessions 200: session_id=%d user_id=%d", session.ID, session.UserID)
	return &session, nil
}

var _ = os.DevNull
